content.text:
Five files use the `QueryCell` defined in `apps/web/lib/QueryCell.tsx`:

- `apps/web/components/apps/CalendarListContainer.tsx` imports it from `@lib/QueryCell`.
- `apps/web/components/apps/installation/EventTypeConferencingAppSettings.tsx` imports it from `@lib/QueryCell`.
- `apps/web/components/dialog/EditLocationDialog.tsx` imports it from `../../lib/QueryCell`.
- `apps/web/modules/apps/installed/[category]/installed-category-view.tsx` imports it from `@lib/QueryCell`.
- `apps/web/components/dialog/__tests__/EditLocationDialog.test.tsx` is a test file. It imports `QueryCell` from `../../../lib/QueryCell` and also mocks that module with `vi.mock`.

`packages/platform/atoms/selected-calendars/wrappers/SelectedCalendarsSettingsPlatformWrapper.tsx` also uses a `QueryCell`, but it's a different one from `@calcom/trpc/components/QueryCell` (`packages/trpc/components/QueryCell.tsx`). I left it out.

I searched by name and import path with `rg`, so a usage under an alias or re-export that doesn't mention `QueryCell` would not show up.
